questionHtml:
The rentals.csv file contains data on 98 short-term rentals in Santa Fe, New Mexico, including the following variables:

    • Superhost -- yes/no indicator for whether rental is managed by a Superhost
    • Cancellation -- yes/no indicator for whether rental policy allows cancellation of reservations without penalty

Customers often prefer to have the option of cancelling a short-term rental if their travel plans change. Are rentals managed by Superhosts more likely or less likely to allow for Cancellation compared to non-Superhosts? Use these data (along with large-sample inference) to fill in the blanks below. 

  • In this sample, the percentage of Superhosts who do not allow cancellation was [ Select ] ["57%", "43%", "64%", "53%", "36%", "32%"] . This is a [ Select ] ["smaller", "larger", "almost identical"] percentage compared to that of non-Superhosts.

  • The 95% large-sample confidence interval for the difference in proportions has an upper limit of approximately [ Select ] ["43%", "0%", "53%", "64%", "21%"] , suggesting that the proportion of rentals that allow for cancellation could be that much higher for [ Select ] ["Superhosts", "non-Superhosts"] .

  • The population difference in proportions is [ Select ] ["not practically significant", "not statistically significant", "practically significant", "statistically significant"] with 95% confidence because the interval contains [ Select ] ["negative values only", "positive values only", "both positive and negative values"] .

  • In this sample, the proportion of all rentals that allow for cancellation is [ Select ] ["52%", "48%", "57%", "21%", "43%"] .
